verdict.rationale: Docs strongly support console/API/CLI provisioning of GPU machines with SSH root access and rapid setup (e.g., 'ML in a Box' preinstalled templates, 'signup to training a model in seconds'), which matches the story well. However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the 'running code within minutes' experience, describing SSH access as 'an uphill battle' with a 'pointless virtual console instead of simple ssh access' and generally poor performance for serious deep-learning use. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks confirming actual provisioning speed, resolution of the SSH-access complaint, and more recent corroborating hands-on reports.
